blind.description: A small hanging sanctuary lamp or votive lantern featuring an ornate gold or brass cage with vertical ribs, a top suspension ring, and a tapered finial at the bottom. Inside sits a deep red ruby-glass cup containing a soft pinkish-white candle or glowing core. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous. The entire model floats suspended in mid-air above the floor without a ceiling chain attached.
blind.from_above: A small circle with a four-point gold cross frame over a glowing pinkish interior and red perimeter, with a small suspension ring visible on one side and a distinct teardrop-shaped shadow extending away.
defects: floats in mid-air without support or ceiling chain
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the figure (around 12 to 14 inches tall) and roughly 6 to 8 inches wide.
